name: ResearchClaw
description: Start or resume the local ResearchClaw workflow from OpenClaw chat.

serverUrl.label: ResearchClaw Server URL
serverUrl.help: URL OpenClaw uses to call the local ResearchClaw HTTP service.

publicUrl.label: ResearchClaw Public URL
publicUrl.help: Optional browser-facing URL shown in chat replies, useful for SSH port forwarding.

requestTimeoutMs.label: Request Timeout
requestTimeoutMs.help: Timeout for calls from OpenClaw to the ResearchClaw server.
